

// package main






type Void = u8;

fn early<'a: 'a>( ) -> (u8) {
    
        

return 7u8;



    
}
fn identity<T>( value: T) -> (T) {
    
        

return value;



    
}
fn pair<A, B>( first: A, second: B) -> ((A, B)) {
    
        

return (first, second);



    
}
fn plain( ) -> (u8) {
    
        

return 5u8;



    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let text = "12"; let callbacks: Option<fn(u8, u16) -> (u8, u16)> = None; let pairs = vec![(1u8, 2u16)];



let first = early::<'static>()
;


let second = identity::<Void>(8u8)
;


let nested = pair::<Option<fn(u8, u16) -> (u8, u16)>, Vec<(u8, u16)>>(callbacks, pairs)
;


let parsed = text.parse::<u16>()

;


let empty = std::iter::empty::<u8>()
;


let native_path = Vec::<u8>::new()
;


let neighbor = plain()
;



let _: u8 = first; let _: Void = second; let _: (Option<fn(u8, u16) -> (u8, u16)>, Vec<(u8, u16)>) = nested; let _: Result<u16, _> = parsed; let _: std::iter::Empty<u8> = empty; let _: Vec<u8> = native_path; let _: u8 = neighbor;



    
}
